status: Complete: incremental delivery retained as 53938a0; controlled regressions fail before the fix and pass after it
hypothesis: DHT peer delivery waits for complete iterative lookup and announcements even after usable peers are known.
controlled: Prove that discovered peers can reach a running transfer before a silent routing referral or announcement is released. Preserve lookup, announcement, cancellation, private-swarm and resource bounds.
public: One fresh v0.18.0-engine Debian session, capped at 60 seconds or 1 MiB from peers; 250 ms snapshots; independently reopen/hash every claimed verified piece. If a tested fix is retained, one fresh follow-up under the same cap. No retries or public-swarm timing causation claim.
isolation: Disposable state/payload, ephemeral port, mapping disabled; leave the GUI client, its data, router configuration and other processes untouched.

controlled_results.baseline: Both stalled-referral and stalled-announcement cases hit the six-second fixture deadline without advancing the transport clock
controlled_results.retained: Peers reach the connector before the outstanding referral or announcement completes; withdrawal drains active delivery and UDP work
controlled_results.scope: Full-metadata torrent discovery; unresolved-magnet delivery is unchanged
controlled_results.limits: Query/search limits, iterative search and announcements retained; early delivery is deduplicated and capped at 256 peers across both identities; malformed lists, filtering, private-swarm revocation and cancellation remain covered

public_qualification: One fresh isolated session per source; DNS caches and swarm availability are uncontrolled. Timings are observations, not causal throughput or latency acceptance. All pieces claimed by each final observed snapshot passed independent reopening/hashing. Own temporary binaries, state and payloads were removed.
